newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Seal says to extend suspension.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Seal says to extend suspension.

text.p: Malaysian timber products firm Seal Inc Bhd said it was planning to extend the suspension of trading in its shares pending an announcement.
It said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange it was finalising the acquisition of a property development project around Kuala Lumpur.
"The full details of the proposed acquisition and development project will be released to the public in due course," it said.
The stock has been under suspension since May 13. But, it did not say for how long it was seeking an extension of the suspension.
